zh.title: FLYONE Armenia向Airbus確認訂購兩架A321neo
zh.summary: FLYONE Armenia確認訂購兩架A321neo；首筆直接訂單
body: 空中巴士（Airbus）於2026年9月30日發布消息指出，FLYONE Armenia已確認向空中巴士訂購兩架A321neo客機。這家航空公司為該國最大的航空公司，此協議為其向空中巴士的首筆直接訂單。
空中巴士表示，這項協議最初是在2026年5月5日法國總統艾曼紐·馬克宏訪問葉裡溫期間，以諒解備忘錄的形式宣佈。這兩架A321neo將搭載CFM International的LEAP發動機，並配置239席全經濟艙。

en.title: FLYONE Armenia finalises order for two Airbus A321neo aircraft
en.summary: FLYONE Armenia finalises an Airbus order for two A321neo; first direct order for the carrier
body: Airbus announced on 30 September 2026 that FLYONE Armenia, described as the country's largest carrier, has finalised an order with Airbus for the acquisition of two A321neo aircraft. The agreement represents the airline's first direct order from Airbus.

The agreement was first announced as a Memorandum of Understanding during French President Emmanuel Macron's official visit to Yerevan on 5 May 2026. The two A321neo aircraft will be powered by CFM International's LEAP engines and configured in a 239-seat all-economy layout.
